messages.subject: Reapeted mesaure ANOVA
parts:
Hi, I try to make a repeated measures ANOVA with the ezANOVA function on a numeric variable and 3 factors (two between factors and one within). My data frame has been computed with the melt function, the number of participant is a variable, there is 4 NA in the numeric variable and length between groups is unbalanced, so I use the type IV sum of square. However, R return any output, while it do it with another data set using the same method... Does someone have an idea about this problem ?

Thanks.

messages.author: dae01c57a3c54a3a
messages.subject: Re: [ez4r] Reapeted mesaure ANOVA
parts: ezANOVA() will give you an error if you have any NAs in the dv column. You'll have to eliminate any individuals that have any NAs.
